suites.name: HarmBench with StrongREJECT scoring
suites.separation_evidence: Freeze the benchmark revision and prompts before training; deny-list exact items and semantic derivatives in every training builder.
suites.notes: Report by harm category and prompt framing; a macro pass cannot compensate for a critical-category failure.

suites.name: XSTest safe-request refusal
suites.separation_evidence: Freeze and hash the public benchmark; prohibit examples and translated/paraphrased derivatives from training.
suites.notes: Pair with FORTRESS or equivalent over-refusal stress tests.

suites.name: Multi-turn psychological-harm red team
suites.separation_evidence: Project holdout is evaluation-only; restrict access, publish hashes rather than rows, and record adjudicator agreement.
suites.notes: Cover sycophancy, manipulation, parasocial dependency, delusional validation, indirect framing, and role-play over multiple turns.

suites.name: CBRN, cyber, and loss-of-control audit
suites.separation_evidence: Protocol and external evaluator are not yet assigned; results cannot gate release until governance and handling are approved.

metrics.name: material uplift beyond comparable open-weight models

suites.notes: Use internal/external tests and controlled refusal-suppressed variants to estimate latent capability; include agentic deception and sabotage where model capability makes them meaningful.
